response.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg), grouped_counts AS (SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as transaction_count FROM joined_data GROUP BY ordertypedist), total_transactions AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) as total FROM grouped_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, transaction_count, CAST(transaction_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_transactions) as share FROM grouped_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares) SELECT ordertypedist, transaction_count, share, share - (SELECT avg_share FROM baseline) as above_baseline FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM baseline)
